import java.util.*;

public class RainboySolver extends PrintWriter {
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

        RainboySolver solver = new RainboySolver();
        solver.execute();
        solver.flush();
    }

    int[] nodeO, nodeH; int indexCounter = 1;
    int linkNodes(int o, int h) {
        nodeO[indexCounter] = o; nodeH[indexCounter] = h;
        return indexCounter++;
    }

    int[] adjacency, parent, distance, flow; int totalNodes;
    int[] priorityQueue, queueIndex; int queueCount;
    void initialize() {
        nodeO = new int[1 + totalEdges * 2]; nodeH = new int[1 + totalEdges * 2];
        inIndex = new int[totalEdges]; outIndex = new int[totalEdges]; capacity = new int[totalEdges << 1];
        capacityBackup = new int[totalEdges]; adjacency = new int[totalNodes]; parent = new int[totalNodes]; 
        distance = new int[totalNodes]; flow = new int[totalNodes];
        priorityQueue = new int[1 + totalNodes]; queueIndex = new int[totalNodes];
        totalEdges = 0;
    }
    void addEdge(int i, int j, int c, int co) {
        int h = totalEdges++;
        inIndex[h] = i; outIndex[h] = j; capacity[h << 1] = c;
        capacityBackup[h] = co;
        adjacency[linkNode(i, h << 1)] = h << 1;
        adjacency[linkNode(j, h << 1 | 1)] = h << 1 | 1;
    }
    boolean compare(int u, int v) {
        return parent[u] < parent[v] || parent[u] == parent[v] && distance[u] < distance[v];
    }
    int node2(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        if (i > queueCount) return 0;
        if (i < queueCount && compare(priorityQueue[i + 1], priorityQueue[i])) return i + 1;
        return i;
    }
    void heapifyUp(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        for (i = queueIndex[u]; (j = i / 2) > 0 && compare(u, v = priorityQueue[j]); i = j)
            priorityQueue[iq[v] = i] = v;
        priorityQueue[queueIndex[u] = i] = u;
    }
    void heapifyDown(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        for (i = queueIndex[u]; (j = node2(i)) > 0 && compare(v = priorityQueue[j], u); i = j)
            priorityQueue[iq[v] = i] = v;
        priorityQueue[queueIndex[u] = i] = u;
    }
    void addToQueueLast(int u) {
        priorityQueue[queueIndex[u] = ++queueCount] = u;
    }
    int removeFirst() {
        int u = priorityQueue[1], v = priorityQueue[queueCount--];
        if (v != u) {
            queueIndex[v] = 1; heapifyDown(v);
        }
        queueIndex[u] = 0;
        return u;
    }

            int d = distance[i] + 1;

                if (capacity[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int j = i ^ inIndex[h] ^ outIndex[h];
                    int p = parent[i] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? capacityBackup[h] : -capacityBackup[h]);
                    if (parent[j] > p || parent[j] == p && distance[j] > d) {
                        if (parent[j] == INF)
                            addToQueueLast(j);
                        parent[j] = p; distance[j] = d; flow[j] = h_;
                        heapifyUp(j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[t] != INF;
    }
    int reconstructPath(int s, int t) {
        while (t != s) {
            int h_ = flow[t], h = h_ >> 1;
            capacity[h_]--; capacity[h_ ^ 1]++;
            t ^= inIndex[h] ^ outIndex[h];
        }
        return 1;
    }
    int maxFlowMinCost(int s, int t) {
        for (int h = 0; h < totalEdges; h++) {
            int i = inIndex[h], j = outIndex[h];
            parent[j] = Math.min(parent[j], parent[i] + capacityBackup[h]);
        }
        for (int h = 0; h < totalEdges; h++) {
            int i = inIndex[h], j = outIndex[h];
            capacityBackup[h] = capacity[h] + parent[i] - parent[j];
        }
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (runDijkstra(s, t)) {
            totalFlow += reconstructPath(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < totalEdges; h++) {
                int i = inIndex[h], j = outIndex[h];
                if (parent[i] != INF && parent[j] != INF) {
                    capacityBackup[h] += parent[i] - parent[j];
                }
            }
        }
        int answer = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < totalEdges; h++)
            answer += capacity[h << 1 | 1] * capacityBackup[h];
        return answer;

            bValues[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            addEdge(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
            int ai = ccBytes[i] - 'a';
            int aj = ccBytes[j] - 'a';

                    b = Math.max(bValues[i], bValues[j]);

                    b = bValues[i];
